from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CourtDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single court document with its identifying title and stated cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document (e.g., '判决文书12')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CourtDocument]
